results.description:
Foot Size Check measures feet with nothing but a sheet of Letter or A4 paper and a photo.

Kids' feet grow fast. Place a foot on Letter or A4 paper, trace around it with a pen, and photograph the sheet. The app reads the outline and measures foot length, width, and a suggested shoe size automatically. No points to line up by hand. The outline is kept at true size.

Features:
- Foot measurement on Letter or A4 paper (length and width)
- Automatic measurement: the traced line is read, heel, toe, and width points are placed for you, and length and width are calculated (you can still adjust by hand)
- Foot outline: the traced line is saved as a true-size shape
- Foot outline card: send it to family right after saving
- Suggested shoe size — a label-size guide: foot length plus 0.5–1.0 cm. This is separate from the inside length measured using an insole
- EU, US and UK conversion in the record detail, and the shoe size shown in your own notation (choose JP, EU, US or UK in Settings)
- Shoe size chart: switch between children, men and women to look up foot length against EU, US and UK
- Growth history saved over time
- Track left and right feet separately
- Fine-tune measurement points by hand
- Growth card: share the latest length, outline, and chart as one image with family
- Insole measuring: trace and photograph a shoe's insole to see the current toe room (about 10 mm is the usual guide, per the Japanese Society for Foot Care and Podiatric Medicine)
- How to fit shoes: checks for choosing shoes, based on podiatry society guidance
- Find shoes: search popular shoes and shoes for specific uses (sports, work, walking, and more) that suit each person's age and sex, in the measured size (Japan; links include advertising)
- My size book: automatically keeps the size that fits each brand, from your shoe notes
- Seasonal shoe reminders: four times a year, a reminder to search for seasonal shoes in the measured size (turn on in Settings; Japan)
- Measurement reminder: at an interval that matches the age (every 3 months up to age 3, 4 months to age 6, 6 months from age 7; guidance from the Japanese Society of Podiatric Medicine)
- Birthday messages: add a birth date and get one quiet greeting that morning
- No account. No banner ads. Links in "Find shoes" include advertising (affiliate links). Photos and records stay on your device (iCloud sync is optional). The developer cannot read your data
- iCloud sync: records and outlines are saved to your own iCloud, come back after a new phone or reinstall, and appear on your other devices (annotated measurement photos stay on the device)

Foot Size Check Pro (optional one-time purchase):
- Same-age reference band on the growth chart (by sex; published survey data from Japan, Spain, or China)
- Shoe replacement estimate: about how many months until the current shoes get too small
- Register more than one child (siblings; one is free)
- Add a second shoe note and beyond (one is free)
- See the growth chart for the whole "All" span
- Remove the Foot Size Check label from growth cards
- A notification when the toe room is likely down to about 5 mm, and an estimate of the toe room in 3 months
- Show in store: one person’s shoe size in extra-large text, filling the screen
- Measuring, records, the growth chart, foot outlines, reminders, and birthday messages are free. Not a subscription

Note: results are estimates only. Shoe fit varies by brand, model, and foot shape. We recommend measuring in person before buying shoes.

Look back at foot photos, outlines and sizes in date order. Outlines share the same scale, and you can overlay two records of the same foot to see how it has grown. Optional foot and profile photos are available across your devices when iCloud sync is enabled.
results.releaseNotes:
It’s now easier to get ready for your first measurement.
• Choose your paper size and start measuring right away

results.description:
OCR Copy turns text in photos, screenshots, and the camera view into text you can copy.

Select up to 20 photos or screenshots at once, and OCR Copy reads them in order and combines the text into one result. The text is copied to your clipboard as soon as it is read, so you can paste it straight into notes, messages, or search.

What you can do:

- Batch: select up to 20 photos or screenshots and get one combined text, in the order you picked them
- Share to OCR Copy: in Photos or right after a screenshot, tap Share and get the text on the spot
- Tables to CSV: when an image has a table, export it as a CSV file, row by row (iOS 26 or later)
- Shortcuts: the "Read Text in Image" action gives you the text of images
- Take a photo and copy its text
- Scan Live: point the camera and copy the text you see
- Fix or remove only the lines you need before copying
- Keep your scanned text and copy it again later
- Auto reads your device's language first. You can also choose the OCR language: Japanese, English, Korean, Chinese, European languages, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai and Vietnamese
- The app is available in 25 languages

Private by design:

- Text recognition runs on your iPhone with Apple Vision
- Works offline. No account, no tracking, no ads
- Photos and text are never sent to a server

Free and OCR Copy Pro:

- Free: read text 5 times a day. One photo with text, one copy from Scan Live, or one shared image counts as one read. Copying, saving and CSV export never count, and the count starts over at midnight
- If you used OCR Copy before version 1.5, reading stays unlimited
- OCR Copy Pro removes the daily limit in the app, the share sheet and Shortcuts. Yearly (with a 1-week free trial) or monthly

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zec-inc.jp/privacy

Note: vertical Japanese text and complex layouts may not be read correctly.

Made by ZEC — simple tools for everyday life.
results.releaseNotes:
Photo won’t read? OCR Copy now notices when a smudged camera lens may be the reason and tells you to wipe it.
It only speaks up when a read comes out poorly, so good photos stay quiet.
Runs entirely on your iPhone (iOS 26 or later), and nothing is sent anywhere.

results.description:
Laundry Tap reminds you when the wash is done and keeps track of when you last did the laundry.

Start a wash or dry timer, put your phone away, and get a notification when the cycle ends. The countdown stays on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. When the clothes are hung up, tap once to log today's laundry. Home then shows how many days it's been since your last wash, and when it's about time again.

■ How it works
1. Tap "Wash 45 min" or "Dry 60 min" (you choose the length)
2. Get a notification when it's done
3. Tap "Hung up" — today's laundry is logged

■ Features
- Wash and dry timers, 5 to 180 minutes. Your last length is remembered
- Live Activity countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Log today's laundry right from the notification
- "Days since last wash" and a gentle status, based on how often you like to wash (every 1–7 days)
- Monthly calendar of your laundry days. Tap any day to add or remove it
- Up to 5 reminders, each with its own time: every day, weekdays, weekends, or the days you pick. It can stay quiet on days you've already washed
- Log your laundry with Shortcuts and Siri, without opening the app

■ Private by design
- No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
- Everything stays on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to a server

■ Good to know
- Laundry Tap doesn't connect to your washing machine. The timer uses the length you set
- It doesn't handle laundromat payments or weather forecasts

Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, log from Control Center, or put the “Mark Laundry Washed” control on Apple Watch with watchOS 26.

Available in 25 languages.
results.releaseNotes:
Missed the end of the wash? Get one gentle nudge 30 minutes later.
Choose 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or turn it off. Tap “Hung up” and no extra notification comes.
Settings now has a gear icon, and the timer fits the narrow Live Activity in the new iOS.

results.description:
No ads, no account, and no internet connection.

Big Text Note shows one note in large, easy-to-read text so you can hold it up to the person in front of you.

It works as a simple communication board: for talking with someone who is deaf or hard of hearing, for the days when your own voice is not available, for noisy places like stations and event halls, or for a quick word at a counter or reception desk. Type it, show it, and if needed, let the device say it.

Read Aloud speaks the note with the voices built into your iPhone or iPad. The language is detected from the text, and nothing is sent to a server.

Voice input turns what the other person says into text on the device. You choose whether to append the result to the note or replace it. Audio is never saved; only the text you keep is stored.

Show mode turns the note into a clear message board. Pick Normal, Large, or Huge, fine-tune the size, and choose text and background colors, including high-contrast pairs. Flip the note upside down for the person across the table, or turn your iPhone sideways for one long line. The screen stays on while Show mode is open. Quick Phrases keeps four ready-made lines and up to 20 of your own, one tap away. Reorder your phrases whenever you like.

Add the Home Screen widget to keep the current note in view. No account, no ads, no tracking, and no server sync. The note stays on your device.

Write to talk, flip for the person across, or open straight from the Lock Screen and Control Center.
results.releaseNotes:
Save up to 20 of your own phrases.
Reorder them to keep the ones you use most at the top.
New in the FAQ: open display mode with a single button press.

results.description:
Study with a chill buddy that grows and talks on tap.
Pair with a friend, too. No rankings.

Tap "Start", then "Stop" when you finish. No setup needed. The timer keeps running even if you close the app, and you can pause anytime.
Every minute you study helps your buddy grow and level up. Taking a break won't shrink your buddy.

Time your study without opening the app
- While the timer runs, the elapsed time and your buddy appear on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with a ring that fills as you study
- Start and stop from your Home Screen widget
- Start and stop from Control Center or the Action button (iOS 18 or later)
- Hold your iPhone to an NFC tag on your desk to start or stop (Shortcuts), or let a Focus do it
- Forgot to stop? After 3 hours you get one reminder, and you can adjust the end time later

Plan what to study today
- Study plans: list what to study today, then tap "Study this" to pick it and its subject before you start
- Paste a study plan made with AI or anywhere else to add many plans at once
- Pick events from your calendar, or connect a Reminders list
- Unfinished plans carry over to the next day. After 7 days, they move to "Someday"

Ambient sounds while you study
- Light rain outside, forest leaves, pencil on paper, and a quiet library. Sounds unlock as your buddy levels up
- They mix with music from other apps and fade out when you pause or take a break

Keep going
- Pomodoro: 25 minutes of focus, 5 of rest. Change the times anytime
- Daily study time goal: set a goal in minutes and see how much is left
- Current goal: write what you're working toward in one line
- Exam countdown: see the days left on the home screen and widgets, with reminders before the exam
- Summary card: after you stop, see the EXP you earned, today's total, and your streak
- Share today's study as a single image
- Focus rating: mark each session "Not great", "OK", or "Great" (optional)
- Study calendar: days you reach your goal get a leaf
- Weekly review: at the end of each week, look back at your total and the subject you studied most
- Study tips: 12 ideas backed by research

See what you studied, and how much
- Choose a subject before you start (or just start without one)
- Forgot the timer? Add records up to 30 days back
- Weekly and monthly charts show time and share by subject
- Add textbooks and workbooks to see your time by material
- Fix the time, subject, note, or focus rating of any record later
- Export your records as CSV
- iCloud sync and backup: switch iPhones and get your sessions and buddy back by turning on sync with the same Apple ID

Study Pair (Study Buddy Pro)
Connect with one partner through an invite link and see their study time today and whether they are studying right now.
Grow one buddy with the time you both put in. On days when both of you do your part, it's a "pair day" and your buddy grows more.
Choose a "cheer" role instead of studying. One cheer a day is enough to take part, which makes it a gentle way to support someone in your family.
Your partner only sees study-time totals. They cannot see when you studied, your subjects, or your notes.
Only the person who creates the pair needs Pro. Invited partners join for free.

Study Buddy Pro (one-time purchase)
- See past weeks, monthly charts, and study calendars for earlier months
- Create a Study Pair
- Ambient sounds: night rain by the window and soft noise
- Add up to 5 exams
No monthly fee. The timer, Pomodoro, four ambient sounds, study plans, materials, records, subjects, daily goal, one exam, this week's chart, this month's calendar, widgets, Lock Screen display, CSV export, and iCloud sync are free.

No ads. Your records are yours
There are no ads. Your study records are saved on this iPhone and never sent to our servers.
If you turn on "Sync with iCloud", they are also saved in your own iCloud, and the developer cannot see them. Data you share in a Study Pair is stored in the pair creator's iCloud.
results.releaseNotes:
Hold your iPhone to an NFC tag on your desk and studying starts. Do it again to stop (set it up in Shortcuts > Automation).
Timing can now stop when your Focus turns off.
Start at a set time or place, with the subject you choose, without opening the app.

results.description:
DailyAlbum keeps one photo a day and hangs it in a frame. A spare iPhone or iPad, or your TV, becomes the frame that shows today's photo.

Use it for family moments, kids' growth, pets, trips, everyday life, plants, creative work, or any small change worth remembering. Open a date, choose one meaningful photo, and let your saved days fill in — no photo editing or social feeds getting in the way. Empty days can even fill themselves: DailyAlbum quietly suggests one good photo — favoring people and pets, skipping screenshots and document shots — all on your device.

◆ Display it
Frame Mode shows today's photo full screen with its date and note. Stand up an iPad or an old iPhone and it becomes a family photo frame. At the start of each month, replay last month as a monthly album.

◆ Never lose it
Turn on iCloud Sync (free, optional) and your photo choices and notes are stored in your personal iCloud, so they survive a new phone or a reinstall. Notes hold up to 300 characters, and you can search them to find that day again in seconds.

◆ Revisit and share
Add the widget to meet a saved moment on your home screen, and get a gentle note when a photo from this day in past years exists. Turn any day into a beautiful card — photo, date, and note — to share in messages or social apps.

◆ Share it with family (DailyAlbum Family)
With the DailyAlbum Family subscription, invited family can view your days in DailyAlbum — one photo per day, like a photo frame in their home. You choose exactly what to share: all daily photos, or only days with a tag you pick. It's view-only and always free for the family you invite. All Plus features are included while the subscription is active.

◆ Privacy
No account is required. By default DailyAlbum shows photos straight from your photo library and doesn't upload them. With iCloud Sync on, your choices and notes are stored in your personal iCloud. If you turn on photo sync (Plus) or share with family (Family), a copy of just those photos is kept in your own iCloud too — never on the developer's servers, and never readable by the developer.

DailyAlbum Plus (a one-time purchase) adds DailyAlbum Archive (a copy of each chosen photo saved inside the app, for steadier and faster viewing), unlimited Frame Mode, unlimited monthly album replays, and multi-device sync. The calendar, photo picking, notes, iCloud Sync, and note search stay free.

DailyAlbum Family is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Viewing is always free for invited family.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zec-inc.jp/privacy
results.releaseNotes:
Jump to On This Day by voice or from search — no digging through the app.
• Type a date or a word from your note in search to open that day's photo
• New step-by-step guide to turning an old device into a photo frame, in Frame Mode settings

results.description:
Choose Mute & Share straight from the share sheet to make a silent copy without opening the app. You can also replace sound with a beep in selected parts.

Mute Video Before Share removes the audio track from a video so you can share it without background voices, conversations, or noise.

Pick a video, tap once, and get a silent copy. Copies without the watermark (Mute Video Pro) keep the video exactly as it is, with no re-encoding, so the picture quality stays the same and even long videos finish fast.

Features:
- Remove all sound from a video in one tap
- No length limit
- Mute Video Pro (optional subscription): save and share copies with no watermark. Free copies get a small watermark in the corner
- The silent copy contains no location or camera metadata from the original
- Your original video stays unchanged
- Preview the silent copy before you save or share it
- No account, no upload, no ads, no tracking - everything runs on your device

Perfect before posting to social media: mute background conversations, wind noise, or anything you would rather keep private.

Available in 25 languages. Works in portrait and landscape on iPhone, and on iPad.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
results.releaseNotes:
Everything you use today stays free: whole-video and part muting, beep, waveform, the share sheet and MP4.
New Mute Video Pro: save and share copies without a watermark.
Got a question? Frequently Asked Questions are now in Settings.

results.description:
Reverse Video Maker plays your videos backwards, sound included. Pick a video, choose the part you want, and get a rewind clip you can save or share.

Spilled water jumps back into the glass. A diver flies out of the pool. A tower of blocks rebuilds itself. Everyday moments get fun when they run in reverse, and the backwards sound makes them even stranger.

How it works:
1. Pick any video from Photos
2. Choose where to start and how long (up to 15 seconds)
3. Tap Reverse, then preview, save to Photos, or share

At a glance:
- Reverse just the part you want, from videos of any length
- The sound plays backwards too, or turn it off for a silent clip
- The free version adds a small logo in the bottom-right corner
- Free, with no ads and no account
- Processed entirely on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded
- Your original video stays untouched
- Keeps the original resolution and frame rate; HDR is correctly converted to SDR
- Speed control: 0.25×, 0.5×, 1×, 1.5× or 2× (UndoCam Pro)
- Boomerang joins forward and reverse, with or without sound (UndoCam Pro)

Good to know:
- Each reversed clip can be up to 15 seconds long (up to 60 seconds with UndoCam Pro).
- UndoCam Pro (optional subscription: yearly with a 1-week free trial, or monthly) removes the logo, allows clips up to 60 seconds and unlocks every speed and Boomerang. If you used UndoCam before 1.4, speeds and Boomerang stay free for you.

Available in 25 languages.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
results.releaseNotes:
New UndoCam Pro: reverse up to 60 seconds at a time.
Pro also keeps your videos logo-free and unlocks every speed and Boomerang (still free if you used UndoCam before 1.4). The yearly plan starts with a free week.
Free videos now carry a small logo in the corner (not if you used UndoCam before 1.4).

results.description:
CleanURL Tap removes tracking parameters from links before you send, save, or post them.

iOS blocks some known tracking, but copied links can still contain UTM campaign tags, affiliate tags, ad click IDs, and long shop parameters. Paste a URL or a whole block of text and CleanURL Tap cleans every link while leaving the rest of the text unchanged.

WHAT IT DOES
- Shows removed parameter names as crossed-out tags
- Cleans all URLs inside text at once
- Works from the share sheet and Shortcuts without opening the app
- Cleans Amazon, Rakuten, eBay, Etsy, AliExpress, social, and general links
- Keeps product choices such as variant, size, color, and quantity
- Lets you choose which cleanup categories are enabled

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Cleanup happens on your device. There is no account, advertising, analytics, link history, or network request for cleanup.
results.releaseNotes:
Remove tracking from every link in a block of text at once.
See each removed parameter, and clean links from Shortcuts or the clipboard.
Everything remains free, ad-free, and on device.

results.description:
WaterDone is the lightest way to keep sipping before you get thirsty.

Had a sip? Tap once. That's the whole app.
No amounts to type. No daily target. The goal is a rhythm: another sip within the interval you choose. A little drop dries out as time passes and fills up when you drink, and a gentle word tells you how you're doing — "Hydrated", "Time for a sip".

• One tap from your Lock Screen or Home Screen widget, without opening the app
• See when your next sip is due, right on the home screen
• A gentle nudge before you dry out. You pick the interval (2–4 hours) and the hours it can reach you. Works fine with notifications off, too
• Tapped by mistake? Undo in one tap
• Just ate? Tap “I just ate” and your next nudge moves later (it isn’t counted as a sip)
• A streak and a simple calendar of every sip
• No account. Everything stays on your device

WaterDone Pro (auto-renewable subscription)
• Log “I had a sip” from Apple Watch, with today’s count and next suggested time on complications
• On hot days, optionally make your usual reminders arrive a little earlier using today’s forecast

Logging, rhythm reminders, “I just ate”, widgets, and writing to Apple Health remain free. If Pro expires, your existing records are not deleted or hidden.

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. A free trial appears only when the App Store reports that you are eligible. The subscription renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and you can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zec-inc.jp/privacy

Hydration that doesn't feel like homework.
WaterDone is not medical advice and does not calculate how much water you need.
results.releaseNotes:
New users now get a short guide to set active hours and optional reminders.
Log your first sip in the guide and start using WaterDone right away.
The guide also offers the one-week WaterDone Pro trial, with an optional reminder the day before it ends.

results.description:
Caffeine Tap helps you keep a daily caffeine log during pregnancy and breastfeeding. See today's total and how much is left before the daily guide you have chosen.

Start by choosing pregnant, breastfeeding, or neither. For pregnancy and breastfeeding, the app sets a guide for your region and shows the organization behind it. Guides vary by country and organization: EFSA uses 200 mg a day, while Health Canada uses 300 mg. You can change your guide. Choose neither to use your own daily guide.

Log a drink with one tap using presets, and adjust the caffeine amount for each of up to 12 presets. Record half a cup, one and a half cups, or two cups, set the time you drank it, and edit or undo an entry. Amounts are standard estimates and vary by product and brewing method.

Review your 7-day and 30-day averages, days above your guide, and your most logged drinks. Browse daily entries in the calendar.

Check today's intake with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. The small Home Screen widget logs the drink at the top of your preset list. Use Siri and Shortcuts to log caffeine and check your day. Lock Screen widgets are for viewing only. With watchOS 26 or later, log 1 cup from Control Center, the Smart Stack, or the Action button on Apple Watch. No Watch app needed.

Turn on Apple Health in Settings to save the caffeine you log (mg) to Health. Sleep is read only to show two averages side by side: nights after days with late caffeine and other nights. The app does not judge how caffeine affects your sleep. Health data is handled on your device and is never sent anywhere.

No account. No ads. Your data stays on your device. The app does not calculate caffeine remaining in your body, predict sleep, or tell you how long to wait before breastfeeding.

This app is for recording caffeine and displaying reference amounts, not for diagnosis or treatment. If you have concerns, consult a doctor or midwife.
results.releaseNotes:
Pregnant or nursing? See how much caffeine is left in your day, one tap at a time, from your Apple Watch or Lock Screen too.
• Future dates and times now show the actual date, not "Just now"
• Clearer wording on the preset editor

results.description:
Food Photo Diary turns your meal photos into a calendar of everyday memories. Just take a photo. Add a dish name or calorie note only when you want to.

Start with a photo
Use the camera or your photo library. The entry takes its time from the photo, and breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack is selected from that time. You can change it later. Add from Photos finds meal photos on your device so you can choose several to record together. Forgot to take a photo? You can still record a dish name or note without one. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, each saved photo also gets a short caption made on your device. It never estimates calories, and you can turn it off.

Add the details later
Tap a photo to edit the dish, calories, notes, date and time. You can also choose a different photo. My Items now keeps photos and notes with your dishes. Tap an item to record the same meal again. The daily calorie total adds up only the values you entered. Set your own daily calorie goal and compare it with the day's total. The app does not recommend a goal. Tag entries as Home cooking, Eating out or Takeout. You can also choose from past entries to add dishes to My Items. Search by dish name or note, and export your entries as CSV.

Optional Apple Health integration
When enabled, this writes only the calories you enter to Apple Health as dietary energy. It does not read any Health data and is off by default.

Choose what to ask an AI
Get a question ready about calorie estimates, meal balance or ideas for your next meal. Hand the question and photos to an external AI app you use, such as ChatGPT or Claude. The app never sends anything to an AI service on its own.

Look back at your meals
Browse the monthly calendar and daily list, see this month's summary and your recording streak, or share your month in meals as one image. A Home Screen widget and optional breakfast, lunch and dinner reminders are included. Reminders are off by default.

Backup
Export your entries and photos together in one file to save in Files or transfer with AirDrop. Restoring only adds to your current entries, without creating duplicates. You can also save photos taken in the app to Photos. Turn this on in Settings; it is off by default.

Your entries are stored on your device (writing to Apple Health happens only when you turn it on). No ads or account required. No judging meals as good or bad.

This app does not provide medical or nutritional advice. AI answers are rough guides.
results.releaseNotes:
Your meal photos now get a few words about what's on the plate, like "Steaming bowl of udon."
Note how you felt after eating with one tap, and see a short look back on each month.
Captions are made only on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence, never estimate calories, and can be turned off.

results.description:
Mark your one daily habit done without opening the app—from Home Screen, Lock Screen, Control Center, or Apple Watch.

No task lists. No planning overload. Name your one thing, tap Done once a day, and see your streak and calendar fill up.

DoneToday is designed to be simple:

- One task at a time, one tap to mark it done
- Current streak, best streak, and a monthly calendar
- Home Screen widgets with a Done button and your last 7 days
- Lock Screen widgets and a Control Center toggle (iOS 18)
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Mark done in DoneToday", or check today's status and your streak in automations
- Optional daily reminder that stays quiet once today is done
- Forgot yesterday? Mark it from the calendar or the one-line prompt
- Starting a new task keeps the old one in Past Tasks
- Export a backup file and restore it on a new iPhone
- Add a one-line note after you finish—what you did today, in your own words
- Share this month's calendar as an image, with your notes if you like

No account. No cloud. Your history stays on your device unless you export a backup yourself.

Made by ZEC — simple tools for everyday life.
results.releaseNotes:
Share your month in your own words: add your one-line notes to the monthly image.
It starts off—switch it on only when you want to share them.
Your notes stay on your device until you choose to share.

results.description:
BaroNote is a simple barometer and personal log.

Check the current air pressure, see whether it is rising, steady, or falling, and save a quick private note about your mood and condition. In History, BaroNote places the available six-hour pressure movement beside your log without judging the cause or making a forecast.

Features:

- Current air pressure from the iPhone pressure sensor when available
- Rising, steady, and falling trend display
- Mood, condition, symptom tags, and optional notes
- History with the available six-hour pressure movement
- Optional Health link for matching condition and mood records
- hPa, mb, inHg, and mmHg units
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- No account, tracking, ads, or server upload

Health linking is optional and off by default. BaroNote writes headache and fatigue, plus mood on iOS 18 or later. It does not read Health data. Sleepiness, low focus, stiff shoulders, pressure, and notes are not written to Health.

Your BaroNote records stay on this device. BaroNote is for personal logging only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or forecasts.
results.releaseNotes:
See how the pressure moved, at a glance.
- A new Graph tab shows the last 24 hours or 7 days of pressure, with a mark wherever you logged how you felt
- Export your records as CSV (records and pressure, two files) for a spreadsheet or a doctor's visit
- Log how you feel with one tap from the Home Screen widget

results.description:
Don't read the forecast. Get the answer.

Today Ready turns local weather into the choices you make before leaving: what to wear, whether to bring a layer, and whether you need an umbrella.

Free features:

- Today's outfit, layer, and umbrella answer
- One morning notification
- Runs-cold and runs-hot adjustment
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- No account, ads, or tracking

With Today Ready Pro:

- Get your umbrella and outfit the moment you leave home — when your home Wi-Fi disconnects, the charger comes off, or your alarm stops. Set it up once with a Shortcuts automation. No "Always" location access needed, and never more than one alert a day
- The whole family at once: add each person's name, icon and runs-cold or runs-hot setting, and see everyone's outfit on the home screen and in notifications. The umbrella is shared

results.description:
PoopTap is a one-tap poop tracker with no ads, no account, and no subscription. Every log lands on a private calendar on your device — and feeds a weird little poop buddy that grows, evolves, and slowly develops opinions about your gut habits.

Tap once after you go. That's the whole workflow. Your log lands on a private calendar, your streak grows, and your poop evolves through stages — from Tiny Poop all the way to Legendary. The Throne Keeper watches over your record and comments on your progress, whether you asked or not.

Under the humor is a genuinely useful bowel movement log: shape and color details, optional symptom marks, a short note per entry, a monthly calendar view, and optional reminders when your record goes quiet. A home and lock screen widget lets you log without opening the app.

Progress is designed to reward consistency, not spam: only a limited daily growth bonus counts toward evolution.

Your logs stay on your device. No accounts, no ads, no analytics. If you turn on Apple Health linking, PoopTap writes only the constipation, diarrhea, and bloating marks you choose; it does not infer symptoms or read Health data. PinLog is a memo app that brings back text and links you want to return to later. Save in a moment, and let the app remember for you.

results.description:
AssetCurve is a simple, private calculator for rough compound-growth estimates.

- Withdrawal: enter your assets and a monthly withdrawal to see roughly how long the money could last.

results.description:
年齢プロフィールは、推しの誕生日・デビュー日と、家族の年齢・節目をひとつにまとめる日本向けのプロフィール帳アプリです。

推しの生誕祭やデビュー記念日まで「あと何日」かを数え、「デビューから◯日」の推し歴もひと目で確認できます。生まれ年がわからなくても月日だけで登録できます。

家族や親族は、満年齢、数え年、生年月日の和暦、干支、星座、一般的な厄年の目安、長寿祝いをまとめて確認できます。「おじいちゃんは今年何歳？」「還暦のお祝いは何年？」にも、このアプリひとつで答えが出ます。

主な使い方:
- 推しの誕生日を登録して、生誕祭まであと何日かを数えます。生まれ年がわからなくても月日だけでOK。家族と並べて確認できます
- 記念日をいくつでも。デビュー日・結成日・結婚記念日・出会った日などを「◯周年まであと◯日」で数え、「デビューから◯日（◯年◯か月）」の推し歴と、次の100日・500日刻みの節目まであと何日かもわかります
- 誕生日や記念日をカード画像にして共有。推しはまる印、家族は角印の和紙カードで、SNSに投稿できます（画像は端末内で作成され、アプリが外部へ送信することはありません）
- 家族・親族のプロフィールを登録して、年齢・和暦・干支・星座を一覧で確認
- 「誕生日の並び」で、これから1年の家族の誕生日を日付順に。次は誰か、何歳・数え何歳になるか、厄年にあたるかがひと目でわかります
- 「今日の暦」で、日の干支と六曜（大安・友引など）を表示。六曜は日本時間の新月から旧暦を計算しています
- 干支の相性: 二人を選ぶと、十二支の三合・支合・冲の言い伝えを紹介します（点数で判定はしません）
- 誕生日や長寿祝い（還暦、古希、喜寿など）の通知を設定
- 西暦・和暦変換ツールで、明治、大正、昭和、平成、令和の年月日を変換。履歴書、申請書、役所手続きの確認にも便利
- ホーム画面・ロック画面のウィジェットで、今年の和暦と次の誕生日・節目を確認
- 子どもの今の学年と、小学校から大学までの入学・卒業年を確認
- 平成32年、昭和100年など、存在しない和暦表記を正しい西暦と元号へ読み替え

安心してお使いいただけます:
- プロフィール、メモ、通知設定はすべて端末内に保存
- アカウント登録不要、広告なし。プロフィールを自動で外部送信しません

無料版では家族を2人、推しを1人まで保存できます。買い切りのPlusを購入すると、家族も推しも人数の上限がなくなります。

このアプリは吉凶や災厄、健康効果などを断定するものではありません。厄年や長寿祝いは一般的な目安として、六曜や干支の相性は暦の言い伝えとして表示しています。有名人の情報はアプリに含まれていません。

・誕生日・記念日をカード画像にして共有。推しはまる印の和紙カードに

results.description:
Number Forge is a daily number puzzle. Every day brings one new
puzzle: combine six numbers with + - x / to forge the target number.

HOW TO PLAY
- Pick two tiles and an operation to forge them into a new number.
- Reach the target in as few operations as you can.
- Par shows the minimum possible. Can you match it?

ONE PUZZLE A DAY
- Everyone gets the same puzzle each day.
- Track solved days, your current streak, longest streak, and par matches.
- Share your result as spoiler-free text.

DAILY LEADERBOARD
- Solved today? See where you stand: "Today: #N of M" on the Game Center Daily Forge leaderboard.
- Scores start at 2,000: each move over par costs 200 points and each second costs 1 (time stops counting at 20 minutes).
- Game Center sign-in is optional. Everything works without it.

NOT QUITE THERE? IT STILL COUNTS
- Finish whenever you like: 2 stars within 10 of the target, 1 star within 25. Stars keep your streak going.
- Once you finish, you can see an example solution.

MORE THAN ONE WAY
- After solving, look for other ways to forge the target.
- Every new way raises your title for the day: Apprentice, Smith, Master Smith, Legend.

WIDGET AND REMINDER
- Add a widget to see today's target, or your solved result, at a glance.
- An optional daily reminder helps you keep the habit. The app works
  fully without notifications.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account required. No ads. No tracking.
- Your progress stays on your device.

PREVIOUS PUZZLES AND LANGUAGES
- Finish today’s puzzle to practice earlier dates locally. Practice never affects rankings, streaks, titles, or stats.
- The app and Widget match all 13 App Store localisations.

- Blur Before Share Pro removes the daily limit. Choose a yearly subscription with a 1-week free trial, or a monthly one.
- Used the app before 1.4? You keep saving and sharing without a limit, no Pro needed.

About the subscription
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your account settings.
